propositions: Bare-repository fixture commands fail under safe.bareRepository=explicit when using implicit discovery (cwd or git -C) instead of explicit --git-dir targeting.

Test fixtures for reclaim/concurrency initialize bare repositories with git config gc.autoDetach false and git symbolic-ref HEAD refs/heads/tickets but invoke them via generic helpers that erase repository-kind intent.

Git 2.55+ intentionally rejects implicit bare-repository discovery under protected safe.bareRepository=explicit policy; the same commands succeed with explicit --git-dir targeting and succeed under default Git configuration.

Production code in infra/scripts/prepare_reclaim_backup.py::_verify_restore creates a throwaway bare repository and routes operations through a worktree-oriented helper, causing the same implicit-discovery rejection under explicit policy.

The supported test suite must run both locally (with explicit safe settings) and in CI (with default config); dismissing reproducible local failures as environmental noise violates AGENTS.md portability and failure-investigation contracts.
